name: Danganronpa The Favourite's Game
source:
After the events of V3, the show shut down, and after a while of no Danganronpa, a new owner brought it back to the public with a brand new death game!

Our main character, Aiden, wakes up in a new location he doesn't recognize, along with 17 other students who have played it all before...

Even when it seems all is known, a dark secret is always stalking the remaining....

[From [url=https://gamejolt.com/games/DanganronpaTheFavouritesGame/999653]GameJolt[/url]]
translation:
V3事件之后，该剧被关闭，一段时间没有《弹丸论破》之后，新主人以全新的死亡游戏将其重新带回公众视野！

我们的主角艾登 (Aiden) 在一个他不认识的新地点醒来，身边还有其他17名曾经玩过这一切的学生……

即使一切似乎都已为人所知，但一个黑暗的秘密却始终在潜伏着剩下的人……

[来自[url=https://gamejolt.com/games/DanganronpaTheFavouritesGame/999653]GameJolt[/url]]
